title: Puka Nacua's 150 yards, Myles Garrett's three sacks carry Rams past Commanders

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Puka Nacua's 150 yards, Myles Garrett's three sacks carry Rams past Commanders
sources.description: Puka Nacua shines with a season-high 150 receiving yards and Myles Garrett records three sacks and forces a fumble in the Rams' 20-13 win over Washington.
